resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Improves retired delivery ceremony (briefs/review/verify/slice/deliver/worker/red-first/hardening checklist)

title: Resolve relative krn review paths and keep deliver hygiene off deleted cwd
body: Outcome: krn review resolves relative --repo/--lens/--checklist against the caller cwd (a zero-cost input error recurred in #164 and #166: '--repo must be an absolute path'); deliver hygiene removes untracked main-checkout task copies that are byte-identical to the merged blobs before fast-forward and never runs a step from the removed worktree (#166: 'untracked working tree files would be overwritten by merge', 'getcwd: cannot access parent directories', exit 1 after a successful merge). Relates to t-zqb0qce.
